Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the form. Happy to share the Type II report and the short KMS/data residency statement. Quick answers up front: 

1) Transfer options: we can provide the final PDF via a presigned S3 link (time-limited), a secure portal download, or SFTP depending on what your security team prefers. Presigned link is fastest for most customers.

2) Consent: we do require an authorization signature for report delivery (standard confidentiality/receipt confirmation). We usually use DocuSign for that; I can send a one-click consent that covers release of the report and a bridge note (if needed).

3) What we can share immediately: the finalized SOC 2 Type II report PDF and a one-page control summary. If you need additional artifacts (telemetry samples, configuration snapshots, or logs), we can provide redacted samples on request but those require additional approvals and an NDA addendum.

To make this low friction, attached is a brief consent template you can circulate internally. If you confirm presigned link + DocuSign workflow, I will: 
- Generate the presigned S3 URL (expires in 7 days)
